transcript.text: A lot of victims aren't going to want to
hear this, but if you want to feel
better, blame other people. If you want
to get better, blame yourself. Blame
feels good in the moment, but it takes
away everything from you in the long
run. When you own your outcomes, you
gain freedom because you now have power.
When you blame others, you give that
power to them because you say they're
the ones who are in control of my life,
not me. You might be 100% justified in
the fact that it isn't your fault. And
now what? Layla says this thing and I
love it. She says, "It might not be your
fault, but it's still your problem."
